entry.title: JC303 0.2.3
entry.summary: # JC303 MPC 0.2.3 — Gen2 Native 303-style acid synth for **Gen2 MPCs (aarch64), MPC OS 3.10.1+**. Hardware testing has been performed on **MPC Live III only**. This release adds Gen2 package metadata, current catalog templates/checks, neutral visible drive-model names and native overlay model selection.
